subject.title: Improve macOS onboarding UX and gateway setup

question: Should maintainers close this stale macOS onboarding PR as superseded by the merged macOS setup work, or sponsor a narrow rebase/cherry-pick of any still-needed UI improvements?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label blocks automated cleanup, and the branch overlaps newer maintainer-led onboarding/security/auth decisions while still carrying P1 blockers.

options.title: Close as superseded
options.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation and treat the merged macOS setup and Crestodian onboarding work as canonical.

options.title: Rebase and narrow
options.body: Ask for a fresh branch on current main that keeps only still-needed UI work and fixes the credentialed probe, acknowledgement bypass, and auth-upgrade behavior before review.

options.title: Keep for design reference
options.body: Leave the PR open only as historical context while remaining remote Gateway UX direction is handled in the linked design issue.

recommendation.title: Close as superseded
recommendation.body: Close this PR after maintainer confirmation and treat the merged macOS setup and Crestodian onboarding work as canonical.

likelyOwner.reason: He authored the merged macOS onboarding/setup PRs that now define the overlapping direction.
